pr_title: audio: change bps format to int64_t
pr_body:
It happens that sample rate can have completely bogus value coming from lavf. Reject that, as we wouldn't do anything useful with it anyway.

Fixes: #13648

issue_context.title: Signed integer overflow UB in `ao.c`
issue_context.body:
### Version information

- mpv version: mpv v0.37.0-484-g665a472098
- Source of the mpv binary: build from source with UBSan enabled

### Reproduction steps

1. Compile commit 665a472 (current master as of writing) with UBSan enabled: `CC=clang meson setup build-ubsan -Dlibmpv=true -Db_sanitize=undefined`
2. Play the sample files with this build:
```
user@laptop:~/fuzz-campaign/hits/samples$ ~/mpv/build-ubsan/mpv UB-ao
 (+) Video --vid=1 (*) (h264 16x8 29.667fps)
 (+) Audio --aid=1 (*) (mp3 1ch 722534400Hz)
[mkv] Invalid EBML length at position 3057
[mkv] Corrupt file detected. Trying to resync starting from position 3057...
[mkv] Cluster found at 9097.
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Invalid NAL unit 0, skipping.
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Invalid NAL unit 0, skipping.
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Invalid NAL unit size (-1226840357 > 3092).
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Error splitting the input into NAL units.
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Invalid NAL unit size (438 > 155).
[ffmpeg/video] h264: Error splitting the input into NAL units.
../audio/out/ao.c:240:30: runtime error: signed integer overflow: 722534400 * 4 cannot be represented in type 'int'
SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior ../audio/out/ao.c:240:30 in 
AO: [pipewire] 722534400Hz mono 1ch floatp
VO: [gpu] 16x8 => 16x9 yuv420p
AO: [pipewire] 11025Hz mono 1ch floatp
Error while decoding frame!
Error while decoding frame!
AV: 00:00:00 / 00:00:01 (40%) A-V:  0.000
Exiting... (End of file)
```

### Expected behavior

No integer overflow in the code.

### Sample files

https://0x0.st/H7xO.mkv

review_comments: this will write an invalid file when `ao->bps > UINT32_MAX`, no?
`bps > UINT32_MAX` is already invalid, so nothing of value will be lost.
I was thinking it could log an error instead of writing a broken file.
